caption: The drawing shows a detailed interior featuring a white ornate fireplace with intricate carved designs and a decorative central medallion. On the mantel sit various objects: two glass domes each containing red and white flowers, two clear candleholders with white candles, two yellow glass vases, and one shorter, clear glass item. Above the mantel is a large, rectangular mirror with an elaborate dark and gold frame topped with a floral crest, reflecting a gold chandelier with white globes. On either side of the fireplace, there is a wooden chair with a carved backrest and a yellow upholstered seat. The walls are covered with wallpaper featuring a repeating pattern of blue and beige designs interspersed with clusters of white and pink flowers. The floor consists of tiles or wood panels in a geometric pattern with shades of brown.
title: Portion of a Drawing Room
